# Number of monitors (`monitor_count`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Device · **Available in:** personal automations

True when the number of connected monitors is within the range. Handy for docked/undocked laptops.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | whole number (≥ 0) | no |  | At least this many monitors. |
| `max` | whole number (≥ 0) | no |  | At most this many monitors. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: monitor_count
    min: 2
```
